MoneyTransferredEvent.description: Evento disparado após uma transferência de dinheiro bem-sucedida.

TransactionDeniedEvent.title: TransactionDeniedEvent
TransactionDeniedEvent.description: Evento disparado quando uma transação é negada por regras de negócio ou validação.

amount.description: O valor que foi tentado transferir.

reason.description: O motivo da negação da transação.

TransactionReversedEvent.title: TransactionReversedEvent
TransactionReversedEvent.description: Evento disparado quando uma transação é revertida com sucesso.

payer.description: O usuário pagador da transação original (pode ser null para depósitos).

UserGoogleLoginResponse.title: User Google Login Response
UserGoogleLoginResponse.description: User data returned after successful Google login.

TooManyRequestsError.title: Too Many Requests Error
TooManyRequestsError.description: Error response when the rate limit for an endpoint is exceeded.

email.description: The user's email address (must be unique).

document.description: The user's CPF (for common users) or CNPJ (for shopkeepers), without formatting.

user_type.description: The type of user being registered.

DepositRequest.title: Deposit Request
DepositRequest.description: Data required for a user to make a deposit.

amount.description: The amount to be deposited. Must be greater than zero.

ReversalRequest.title: Reversal Request
ReversalRequest.description: Data required to request a transaction reversal.

original_transaction_id.description: The UUID of the original transaction to be reversed. This transaction must exist.

reason.description: The reason for the reversal. Must be at least 10 characters long.
reason.example: Duplicate transaction due to system error.

TransferRequest.title: Transfer Request
TransferRequest.description: Data required for a user to initiate a money transfer.

payee_id.description: The UUID of the user who will receive the transfer. Must be an existing user and cannot be the payer's own ID.

amount.description: The amount to be transferred. Must be a positive number greater than zero.

UserStoreRequest.title: User Store Request
UserStoreRequest.description: Data required to create a new user by an administrator.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The unique email address for the user.

document.description: The unique document number (CPF or CNPJ) for the user. Only digits.

password.description: The user's password. Must be at least 8 characters and confirmed.

password_confirmation.description: Confirmation of the user's password. Must match 'password'.

user_type.description: The type of user being created.

UserUpdateRequest.title: User Update Request
UserUpdateRequest.description: Data required to update an existing user by an administrator.

name.description: The updated full name of the user.

email.description: The updated unique email address for the user.

document.description: The updated unique document number (CPF or CNPJ) for the user. Only digits.

password.description: The new password for the user. Optional. Must be at least 8 characters and confirmed if provided.

password_confirmation.description: Confirmation of the new password. Required if 'password' is provided and must match 'password'.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a financial transaction within the system.

id.description: The unique identifier of the transaction.

payer_id.description: The ID of the user who initiated the transaction (payer). Null for deposits.

payee_id.description: The ID of the user who received the transaction (payee).

amount.description: The amount of money involved in the transaction.

status.description: The current status of the transaction.

reverted_from.description: The ID of the original transaction that this transaction reversed (if type is reversal).

reason.description: The reason for the transaction status (e.g., denial reason, reversal reason).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

TransactionReversal.title: Transaction Reversal
TransactionReversal.description: Represents a record of a transaction reversal, linking the original transaction to the new reversal transaction.

id.description: The unique identifier of the transaction reversal record.

original_transaction_id.description: The ID of the original transaction that was requested to be reversed.

reversal_transaction_id.description: The ID of the new transaction of type 'reversal' generated in the system. Null if the reversal failed or is pending.

reversed_by_user_id.description: The ID of the user (e.g., administrator) who initiated or approved this reversal request.

reason.description: The reason provided for the transaction reversal.
reason.example: Customer requested cancellation within cooling-off period.

status.description: The current status of the reversal request process.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the reversal record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the reversal record was last updated.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system, either a common user, a shopkeeper, or an administrator.

id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The unique email address of the user.

document.description: The unique CPF (for common users) or CNPJ (for shopkeepers), containing only digits.

balance.description: The current monetary balance of the user, with 2 decimal places.

google_id.description: The Google ID if the user registered via Google OAuth.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

TransactionResponse.description: Schema representing a transaction, including details about sender and recipient.

UnauthorizedReversalError.description: Returned when a user attempts to reverse a transaction they are not authorized to reverse.

message.example: Você não tem permissão para reverter esta transação.
